notes: Sanctum of All. Printed: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a Shrine card and put it onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle.' At turn 3's upkeep seat 0 fires the may and searches its library only (option 1): the library holds Shrine L and a plain Enchantment (not a Shrine); the graveyard holds Shrine G, which a library-only search never sees. Shrine L enters the battlefield under seat 0's control; Shrine G stays in the graveyard; the plain Enchantment stays in the library. The library was searched, so it is shuffled (the order below is the seeded shuffle of the six filler cards and the plain Enchantment; the draw step then takes the shuffled top). Unshuffled, the remaining order would be Library 4, 3, 2, 1, 0, Plain Enchantment (see K01_6), so this exact order pins the shuffle.
